lessons.title: हूं काल (kāl) जासूं (jāsū̃) — I will go
lessons.gloss: I will go: the future, said of yourself

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say I went to the market yesterday. The same काल (kāl) also points the other way, to tomorrow.
Add -सूं to a stem and you have I will:
हूं काल बाजार जासूं। hū̃ kāl bājār jāsū̃. — I will go to the market tomorrow.

No हूं at the end: the future stands on its own. Every stem takes it the same way: आसूं, खासूं, बोलसूं, समझसूं. CDIAL quotes an Old Marwari line with this future in it, "I will fan" (CDIAL 5593). The spelling -सूं is central Marwari as this book writes it; other districts differ.
You know two set phrases that look ahead: पाछे मिलसू and कितणो आखरी भाव दोगे? Keep saying them as you learned them.

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.instruction: हूं काल आसूं। — hū̃ kāl āsū̃. — I will come tomorrow.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं काल आसूं।** — *hū̃ kāl āsū̃.* — I will come tomorrow.]

segments.instruction: हूं आथण दूध पीसूं। — hū̃ āthaṇ dūdh pīsū̃. — I will drink milk in the evening.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं आथण दूध पीसूं।** — *hū̃ āthaṇ dūdh pīsū̃.* — I will drink milk in the evening.]

segments.instruction: हूं काल बाजार जासूं। — hū̃ kāl bājār jāsū̃. — I will go to the market tomorrow.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं काल बाजार जासूं।** — *hū̃ kāl bājār jāsū̃.* — I will go to the market tomorrow.]
[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: I will go? (जासूं (jāsū̃).) I will come? (आसूं.) What comes after it? (Nothing.)

segments.prompt: Say that you will go to the market tomorrow.

feedback.correct: Right: जा, then -सूं, and nothing after it.
feedback.incorrect: The future is the stem and -सूं: जासूं.

lessons.title: हूं काल (kāl) कोनी जासूं (konī jāsū̃) — I won't go
lessons.gloss: I won't go: कोनी in front of the future

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say I will come tomorrow. Then I don't drink tea.

blocks.title: Grammar Lens: कोनी before the future

segments.text: कोनी goes in front of the future, as it does in front of the present:
हूं काल कोनी जासूं। hū̃ kāl konī jāsū̃. — I won't go tomorrow.
हूं परसूं कोनी आसूं। hū̃ parsū̃ konī āsū̃. — I won't come the day after tomorrow.

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.instruction: हूं मांस कोनी खासूं। — hū̃ mā̃s konī khāsū̃. — I won't eat meat.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं मांस कोनी खासूं।** — *hū̃ mā̃s konī khāsū̃.* — I won't eat meat.]

segments.instruction: हूं आज बाजार कोनी जासूं। — hū̃ āj bājār konī jāsū̃. — I won't go to the market today.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं आज बाजार कोनी जासूं।** — *hū̃ āj bājār konī jāsū̃.* — I won't go to the market today.]
[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: I won't go? (कोनी जासूं (konī jāsū̃).) I don't go? (कोनी जाऊं.)

segments.prompt: Say that you won't go tomorrow.

feedback.incorrect: Put कोनी in front of जासूं.

lessons.title: काल (kāl) — yesterday or tomorrow
lessons.gloss: yesterday or tomorrow: the verb decides

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say I won't go tomorrow. Then say काल (kāl) and परसूं on their own.
काल (kāl) is one word for two days, and the verb tells you which:
हूं काल गयो। hū̃ kāl gayo. — I went yesterday.
हूं काल जासूं। hū̃ kāl jāsū̃. — I will go tomorrow.
परसूं works the same way, for the day before yesterday or the day after tomorrow.

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.instruction: राम काल आयो। — rām kāl āyo. — Ram came yesterday.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **राम काल आयो।** — *rām kāl āyo.* — Ram came yesterday.]

segments.instruction: हूं काल आसूं। — hū̃ kāl āsū̃. — I will come tomorrow.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं काल आसूं।** — *hū̃ kāl āsū̃.* — I will come tomorrow.]

segments.instruction: मां परसूं आई। — mā̃ parsū̃ āī. — Mother came the day before yesterday.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **मां परसूं आई।** — *mā̃ parsū̃ āī.* — Mother came the day before yesterday.]
[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: In हूं काल (kāl) गयो।, which day? (Yesterday.) In हूं काल (kāl) जासूं (jāsū̃)।? (Tomorrow.)

feedback.correct: Right: आयो is a past, so काल is yesterday.
feedback.incorrect: A past verb makes काल yesterday: राम काल आयो.

lessons.title: Tomorrow — a review
lessons.gloss: review of the future, its negative, and काल

[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: I will go? (जासूं.) I won't go? (कोनी जासूं (konī jāsū̃).) I went? (गयो.)

segments.prompt: Say: I went yesterday, but I won't go tomorrow.
acceptedResponses: हूं काल गयो पण काल कोनी जासूं।
हूं काल गई पण काल कोनी जासूं।
hū̃ kāl gayo paṇ kāl konī jāsū̃
hu kal gayo pan kal koni jasu

feedback.correct: Right: the past makes the first काल yesterday, the future makes the second tomorrow.
feedback.incorrect: गयो for yesterday, कोनी जासूं for tomorrow.
